stories.title: Token Revocation and Validation API
stories.description: Implement backend endpoints and internal service methods for validating bearer tokens, revoking active tokens, and checking expiration/rotation status during GPTReader access. Ensure compatibility with existing auth flow in gpt_reader and Shared brain_auth utilities.
